title: Distinct Subsequences
description:
Count how many choices of positions in s spell t when read from left to right. You may delete characters from s but cannot rearrange the ones kept. Choices of different positions count separately even if they spell the same text.

The empty target is formed once by selecting no positions, including when the source is empty. Count position choices, not different resulting strings.

Example 1:

Input: s = "rabbbit", t = "rabbit"
Output: 3

Any one of the three consecutive b positions can be omitted.

Example 2:

Input: s = "babgbag", t = "bag"
Output: 5

Five different index choices spell bag.

Example 3:

Input: s = "", t = ""
Output: 1

The empty selection spells the empty target once.

Constraints:

  • 0 <= s.length, t.length <= 30
  • Both strings contain only lowercase English letters.
  • The answer fits a signed 32-bit integer.
